description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Price on Big Onions
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes a maximum retail price for a specific commodity (Big Onions) and removes a previous order, which constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments.
